analysis_role: Post-result spatial-scale decomposition of the already-fixed orientation transition-regime H1; no predictor, vector, taxon panel or region assignment was changed after execution.

region_frequency_preserving_null.definition: Preserve the observed number of downward states separately in Japan (3/8) and Taiwan (2/4), giving 336 state maps.

Taiwan.resolution_note: 1/6 is the finest possible one-sided exact rank in the four-taxon 2U/2D panel.

interpretation.primary: The positive orientation transition-regime concordance is not generated by the Japan-versus-Taiwan mean climate contrast. The between-region component is slightly opposite to the fixed H1 direction, whereas the within-region component retains and slightly strengthens the observed positive concordance.
interpretation.regional_state_composition: Region-specific U/D frequencies do not explain the result: the total and within-region statistics remain exceptional after conditioning on the observed Japan and Taiwan state counts.
interpretation.single_region_panels: Japan-only remains directionally positive but is not exceptional in its 56-map universe; Taiwan-only is the top-ranked map but has only six possible maps, so its exact finite-map resolution is too coarse for a <=0.05 rank.
interpretation.paper_claim: Orientation present-niche transition concordance is carried by taxon-level climatic differences within the Japan and Taiwan regional contexts rather than by a coarse Japan-Taiwan regional mean difference.

claim_ceiling: This is a post-result scale decomposition, not an independent preregistered replication.
Japan and Taiwan are the only region classes in the frozen occurrence assets used here; do not generalize to all East Asia without new data.
Finite-map fractions are conditional ranks, not biological-replicate P values.
The result identifies present-niche spatial organization, not climatic causation, historical transition-time environment, selection, adaptation or a physiological mediator.
